questions.stem: The ____ (students) classroom is on the second floor.

options.distractor: 这里指多个学生共用的教室
已带 s 的复数只加撇号

questions.explanation: 复数且已带 s，所有格只加 '：students' classroom。

questions.stem: The door ____ the room is broken.
questions.explanation: 无生命名词用 of 表示所属：the door of the room。

questions.stem: ____ mothers are both doctors in the same hospital.

options.distractor: 共同所有意味着一位妈妈，与 mothers are both 矛盾

questions.explanation: 两位妈妈 → 各自所有，两个名词都加 's。

questions.stem: — Where are you going? — To my ____. He is ill in hospital.

options.distractor: 要用所有格表示“叔叔家”
这里是一位叔叔，用单数所有格

questions.explanation: my uncle's 表示“我叔叔家”（省略了 house/home）。

options.text: The students' books are on the desk.
This is Lily and Lucy's mothers.
The window of the classroom is open.

questions.explanation: 两位妈妈是各自所有，应改为 Lily's and Lucy's mothers。

questions.stem: It's about ten ____ walk from my home to school.

options.distractor: 表示“十分钟的”要用所有格

questions.explanation: 复数所有格：ten minutes' walk（步行十分钟的路）。
